one_liner_zh: Alphabet Inc.（GOOGL）最新季度財報超預期，EPS達2.82，超出預估6.78%
one_liner_en: Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings with an EPS of 2.82, beating estimates by 6.78%
beat_or_miss: 超預期，主要因為公司的廣告業務和雲端服務表現強勁
highlights_zh: 公司的廣告業務和雲端服務表現強勁
highlights_en: Strong performance in advertising and cloud services
risks_zh: 全球經濟不確定性可能影響廣告支出
雲端服務市場競爭加劇
risks_en: Global economic uncertainty may impact ad spending
Increasing competition in the cloud services market
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本季財報顯示Alphabet Inc.的核心業務仍然強勁，但全球經濟不確定性和雲端服務市場競爭加劇可能對公司的未來表現造成影響，需追蹤公司的廣告業務和雲端服務發展
ai_view_en: view: The quarterly earnings signal a strong core business, but global economic uncertainty and increasing competition in cloud services may impact future performance; key metrics to track include ad revenue and cloud services growth
